title: Don’t Let Your Robot be Harmful: Responsible Robotic Manipulation via Safety-as-Policy
reasoning: The paper focuses on the physical safety and hazard avoidance of robots in real-world scenarios (e.g., avoiding fires, electrical shocks, or injuring children).
